title: How to Spot Leading Stocks Before It's Obvious
description:
Every week the market tells you where the real leadership is, if you know how to read it. The Flow Dashboard is OptionsPlay's new relative-strength framework that sorts the market's leaders into three tiers so you can see at a glance what's confirmed, what's building, and what's just starting to work.

In this video, Tony Zhang (Chief Strategist, OptionsPlay) walks through the latest Flow Leadership readings for stocks and ETFs, explains the three-tier system, Confirmed, Building, and Early Breakout, and highlights the themes leading this market: Semis & AI Core, Travel & Leisure, Fintech & Payments, International Banks, and Crypto-adjacent names.

This is the same research framework we use internally to size risk and rotate exposure. You'll come away with a shortlist of 48 stocks and 17 ETFs actively leading the tape right now, and a repeatable way to track leadership going forward.
